classification: prospective immutable Apple prepare_layer full-code, bounded path-marker, and selected aggregate-origin hardware-writer capture; the antecedent early-arm branch bypass, exact code identities, source-selection rule, marker inventory, watchpoint arm order, coverage thresholds, validators, and implementation hashes were fixed before observing this experiment; writer semantics, the complete public crop policy, unseen transfer, and product parity remain sealed
objective: Capture all 40,128 bytes of Apple's exact prepare_layer symbol and the next real write to the selected source's changing x19+656 aggregate origin, replacing the falsified assumption that either prepare_layer+0x32c0 or +0x33f0 must execute for this workload with direct control-flow and hardware-watchpoint evidence.

openedEvidenceBoundary.conclusion: Both guessed construction sites were armed during the first exact prepare_layer callback, before the later capture_backdrop selector existed, but neither site executed during the complete 33-frame workload. The changing selected aggregate therefore enters through another path.

priorLiveRoleEvidence.basisForEightByteOriginWatchpoint: The selected x19+656 binary64 origin changes across the captured materialization states, so an aligned eight-byte write watchpoint is sufficient to expose at least one subsequent overlapping writer while leaving three hardware slots unused.

captureDesign.entryGate: Break on the exact prepare_layer name; require both callback PC and breakpoint-location address to equal the symbol start; require the symbol to contain exactly 40,128 bytes; capture all bytes before installing internal breakpoints; and revalidate five independently captured 4 KiB windows plus the exact union_bounds symbol identity and code hash.
captureDesign.sourceSelection: Independently select the first capture_backdrop+0x2b58 candidate with the exact x19/x20/x24 pointer chain, owner binary64 rectangle equal to the layer-state integer rectangle, and source integer rectangle still different.
captureDesign.markerRule: Install all thirteen fixed instruction-address markers before the first prepare_layer invocation resumes. Retain every bounded preselection record; after source selection reject any live x28 that is not the exact selected source. Every retained record includes x19/x28 aliases, bounded registers and backtrace, and 2 KiB of x19 role state.
captureDesign.watchpointArmRule: At source selection, retrospectively classify the retained records and arm from the most recent exact-source watch-arm marker. If none exists, arm from the first subsequent live exact-source watch-arm marker. In either case record exact provenance and watch eight write-only bytes at x19+656.
captureDesign.watchpointEventRule: Retain at most 24 hits. Every event records the chained before/after eight bytes, change predicate, stop PC and frame, bounded backtrace, containing PC-centered 4 KiB code, all general and SIMD registers, 2 KiB stack, four selected object prefixes, register-pointer probes, readable 2 KiB x19-through-x28 role probes, private fields, and the complete watched role after the write.
captureDesign.semanticSeal: The CI validator may prove only exact code and object identity, marker and watchpoint provenance, payload integrity, bounded coverage, at least one changed writer event, and existing timeline gates. It may not interpret the writer instruction or infer a universal crop rule.
captureDesign.nullOutcome: Any Apple code drift, non-entry callback, source-selection failure, late marker installation, truncated marker stream, missing selected later site, fewer than three distinct selected aggregates, watchpoint-arm failure, no changed event, incomplete operand capture, callback-accounting mismatch, debugger failure, stopped target, or existing timeline-validator failure fails closed while preserving the artifact.
